en.title: 2026 Academic Year Foreign Language Proficiency Scholarship Selection Notice (~Nov 17)
summary: A scholarship of 500,000 KRW will be awarded to undergraduate students enrolled in regular semesters for 2026-2 who meet the minimum criteria on designated certified foreign language tests.
Recognized tests and cut-offs are TOEIC 950+, TOEIC-Speaking 180+, TOEFL (IBT) 112+, JLPT N1, New HSK Level 6, and Dalf C1.

Applications must be submitted in person to the student's affiliated college administration office from October 29 (Thu) to November 17 (Tue), 2026, 18:00 (office hours 09:00–18:00; lunch break 12:00–13:00, weekends, and public holidays excluded).
Required documents are the Foreign Language Proficiency Scholarship Application Form and a copy of the score report.
Students exceeding 8 semesters (10 semesters for Architecture), partial registrants (부분등록자), and previous recipients are not eligible.
en.easyExplanation: This scholarship offers 500,000 KRW to undergraduate students enrolled in a regular semester for 2026-2 who achieved certified foreign language scores (TOEIC, TOEIC Speaking, TOEFL, JLPT, HSK, or Dalf) meeting the minimum criteria within the designated testing period. It can be received only once during enrollment, and students who have exceeded 8 semesters (10 for Architecture) or are registered for partial credits (부분등록자) are not eligible. Submit your completed application form and score report copy in person to your college administration office by November 17 at 18:00.
en.target: Undergraduate students enrolled in a regular semester for 2026-2 (who took the designated foreign language test between Nov 2025 and Oct 2026 while enrolled; first-year students are accepted only for scores obtained after admission; French Dalf has no test period restriction as long as it was obtained after admission; students expected to graduate in Feb 2027 may apply) meeting the score/level criteria (TOEIC 950+, TOEIC-Speaking 180+, TOEFL IBT 112+, JLPT N1, New HSK Level 6, Dalf C1). Excluded: students exceeding 8 semesters (10 for Architecture), partial credit registrants (부분등록자), past recipients of the foreign language proficiency scholarship or the previous TOEIC scholarship during enrollment, and those disqualified under Articles 10 and 12 of the Scholarship Regulations.

en.title: [IPP] Recruitment of Students for the 1st Half of 2027 Work-Learning Dual System (★Early closing by job position possible★)

summary: Notice regarding selection of recipients for the 2026 Tongyeong City Low-Income University Student Scholarship (living expense scholarship, capped at 1,000,000 KRW per person).

Eligible applicants are university students belonging to the Basic Living Security (기초생활수급자) or near-poverty group (차상위 계층) who graduated from high school in Tongyeong, have resided in Tongyeong and attended local schools for 6+ years as of the announcement date, and earned a C average grade or above in the 1st semester of 2026.

Graduate students, students on leave of absence (휴학생), prior recipients of this scholarship 4 or more times, and recipients of specified other scholarships or living expense scholarships are excluded.
The application period is from November 2, 2026 (Mon) 09:00 to November 23, 2026 (Mon) 18:00.
Applications must be submitted in person or by mail (postmarked by the deadline) to the Lifelong Education Division (평생교육과) of Tongyeong City.

Required documents issued after the announcement date include application form, proof of basic living security/near-poverty status, certificate of enrollment (재학증명서), transcript (성적증명서), school record (생활기록부), resident registration abstract (주민등록초본), and bankbook copy.
en.easyExplanation: This notice details a living expense scholarship (up to 1,000,000 KRW) for university students from Tongyeong who belong to the basic living security or near-poverty group. Eligible candidates must have graduated from a high school in Tongyeong, lived in Tongyeong and attended local schools for at least 6 years, and achieved a C grade average or higher in the 1st semester of 2026; students on leave of absence (휴학생), graduate students, and recipients of certain other scholarships are excluded. Submit the required documents in person or by mail to the Tongyeong Lifelong Education Division by 18:00 on November 23, 2026.
en.target: University students belonging to the Basic Living Security (기초생활수급자) or near-poverty group (차상위 계층) under the National Basic Living Security Act who graduated from high school in Tongyeong, have had a registered address in Tongyeong for 6+ years and attended schools in Tongyeong for 6+ years as of the announcement date, and achieved an average academic grade of C or above in the 1st semester of 2026. (Excluded: those who received the Tongyeong City Low-Income University Student Scholarship 4+ times, recipients of the 2026 Tongyeong City Academic Excellence Scholarship, Regional University Student Scholarship, or Talent Fostering Scholarship, recipients of living expense scholarships, graduate students, students on leave of absence (휴학생)).

en.title: [Undergraduate Off-Campus Scholarship] Notice on 2027 22nd Electrical Contractors Financial Cooperative Scholarship Foundation Student Selection
summary: Notice on selection of scholarship recipients for the 2027 22nd Electrical Contractors Financial Cooperative Scholarship Foundation (up to 5 million KRW annually for tuition, max 2.5 million KRW per semester).

Eligible candidates are students currently enrolled in electrical-related departments (General stream) or representatives/executives/employees and their children of members registered with the Electrical Contractors Financial Cooperative (Member stream) as of the application date, with a GPA of 3.0+ (out of 4.5) and 12+ credits completed in the most recent completed semester.

Excluded from selection: prospective university entrants, those planning to take a leave of absence or extra semesters in 2027, those receiving other external scholarships in 2027 (except in-school/national scholarships), those subject to disciplinary action, and those with household monthly average income at or above 200% of the median income.
Application period: November 2, 2026 (Mon) 09:00 ~ November 13, 2026 (Fri) 18:00.
Online application only via foundation website (www.ecfcsf.or.kr; email, mail, or in-person submissions not accepted).

Required documents: Checklist & Self-Introduction, Transcript, Family Relation Certificate, Financial Status Documentation (local tax certificate, income certificate), and (Member stream only) Employment Certificate from member firm.
en.easyExplanation: The Electrical Contractors Financial Cooperative Scholarship Foundation is recruiting scholarship students for 2027 targeting students in electrical-related majors and cooperative members' families. Enrolled students with a GPA of 3.0 or higher and at least 12 credits completed in their most recent completed semester may apply, while those planning leaves of absence, extra semesters, or receiving other external scholarships in 2027 are excluded. Applications must be submitted online via the foundation website by 18:00 on November 13, 2026.
en.target:
Students currently enrolled (재학생) in electrical-related departments as of the application date (General stream) or member representatives, executives, employees, and their children registered with the Electrical Contractors Financial Cooperative (전기공사공제조합) as of the application date (Member stream), who achieved a GPA of 3.0/4.5 or higher and completed 12+ credits (이수학점) in the most recent completed semester.
[Exclusions]
- Prospective university entrants (대학입학 예정자)
- Those scheduled to receive scholarships from other external organizations in the 1st or 2nd semester of 2027 (except in-school and national scholarships within actual tuition cost)
- Those planning to take a leave of absence (휴학 예정자) or extra semesters (초과학기 이수예정자) in 2027
- Those subject to disciplinary action (징계처분) or deemed contrary to the foundation's purpose
- Those whose household monthly average income is 200% or more of the 2025 median income (for 4-person household) (unless total applicants fall short)

How to Apply: Online application via the foundation's website.

en.title: [Undergraduate - In-School Scholarship] 2026 Foreign Language Proficiency Scholarship Selection Notice
summary: Selection for the Foreign Language Proficiency Scholarship for undergraduate students enrolled in a regular semester for 2026-2 (Scholarship amount: 500,000 KRW)

Open to students meeting score/level criteria for designated official foreign language tests (TOEIC 950, TOEIC-Speaking 180, TOEFL iBT 112, JLPT N1, New HSK Level 6, Dalf C1); excludes students exceeding standard semesters, partial registrants, and previous TOEIC scholarship recipients
Application period: 2026. 10. 29.(Thu) ~ 11. 17.(Tue) (Submissions accepted 09:00 ~ 18:00 during business hours; excludes lunch hour 12:00~13:00, weekends, and holidays)
Application method: Submit the application form and a copy of the official score report in person to the student's affiliated college administration office
Result announcement and scholarship payment: Mid-December 2026 (deposited into the personal bank account registered on the portal or applied to loan repayment)
en.easyExplanation: This scholarship offers 500,000 KRW to undergraduate students enrolled in the 2026 Fall regular semester who meet the score criteria in designated official foreign language tests. Students exceeding 8 semesters (10 for Architecture), partial registrants, and prior recipients of the TOEIC scholarship are not eligible. Eligible students must submit the application form along with their score report in person to their college administration office by 18:00 on November 17, 2026.
en.target: Undergraduate students enrolled in a regular semester for 2026-2 who took a designated official foreign language test between November 2025 and October 2026 while enrolled at Inha University and meet the score/level criteria (For 1st-year students, only scores obtained after matriculation are recognized; Dalf has no test-date restriction but scores must be obtained after matriculation; students graduating in February 2027 are eligible). Can only be received once during the entire period of enrollment. Excluded: previous recipients of the TOEIC scholarship, students exceeding 8 semesters (10 semesters for Architecture), partial registrants (부분등록자), and individuals ineligible under Articles 10 (Restrictions on Eligibility) and 12 (Restrictions on Benefit) of the Scholarship Regulations.

en.title: [Undergraduate - Off-Campus Scholarship] Notice on 2026 Fall Semester Tuition Support Project for University Students from Geochang-gun
summary: A project supporting out-of-pocket tuition expenses for university students from Geochang-gun up to 1,000,000 KRW per semester.

Applicants must meet all criteria: under 30 years old, applied for 2026-2 Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단) National Scholarship, in their final year or the year directly prior to the final year, completed at least 12 credits with a GPA of 2.5 or higher in the previous semester, and meet residency/graduation requirements in Geochang-gun.

Applications must be submitted in person or by registered mail to the relevant local administrative welfare center by November 16, 2026, at 18:00.
en.target: University students from Geochang-gun who satisfy all of the following requirements: 1) Under 30 years of age (born after October 15, 1996), 2) Applied for the 2026-2 National Scholarship via the Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단), 3) Final year student or the year directly prior to the final year, 4) Completed at least 12 credits and achieved a GPA of 2.5 or higher in the previous semester (for returning students, grades from the semester immediately prior to leave of absence apply), 5) Residency requirement (Student: continuously held resident registration in Geochang-gun for 3+ years as of the announcement date, or attended for 3 years and graduated from a middle or high school in Geochang-gun / Family: at least one family member among parents, grandparents, maternal grandparents, or spouse has continuously held resident registration in Geochang-gun for 3+ years as of the announcement date).

en.title: [Reserve Forces Regiment Headquarters] 2026 Basic (Carried-over) Training Notice (2nd)
summary: This notice guides the 2026 Basic (Carried-over) Training (기본(이월)훈련); individual training dates must be checked via personal mobile call-up notices (Kakao/Naver electronic documents) or the Reserve Forces website.

Required items include identification (mandatory) and designated uniform (combat cap, combat uniform, combat boots); students needing uniform rental must submit a rental application to the Reserve Forces Regiment Headquarters at least 3 days prior to training.

Those who need training postponement (due to medical diagnosis, exam registration slips, etc.) must visit the Reserve Forces Regiment Headquarters before the training (students abroad on the training date are automatically postponed).

All reserve members must update their account information on the Reserve Forces website to receive stipends, but accessing the website on the actual training day is strictly prohibited to prevent system errors.
en.easyExplanation: This notice provides guidelines for the 2026 Basic (Carried-over) Reserve Forces Training. Eligible reserve members must attend on the date indicated on their personal mobile call-up notice and enter the Namdong-gu Training Center by 09:00 with proper uniform and ID (students abroad on the training date are automatically postponed). To avoid system errors, you must not access the Reserve Forces website on the day of your training.
en.target: Reserve members (예비군대원) assigned to the 2026 Basic (Carried-over) Training (students who are abroad on the training date are automatically postponed and exempt).

en.title: [Inha Innovation Center for Engineering Education] 2026 Corporate & Social Problem Solving Project Participation Notice (Registration Period Extended)
summary: Extension of application period for participating teams in the '2026 Corporate & Social Problem Solving Project' hosted by the Inha Innovation Center for Engineering Education.
Undergraduate teams of 3 or more (must include at least 1 engineering student in their 3rd year or above) can choose between the In-depth Project or Competition Project track.
Application period: October 14, 2026 (Wed) – October 27, 2026 (Tue) via the Next-Generation Semiconductor Consortium website (ngscc.kr).
Required documents: 1 copy each of Application Form, Proposal, Consent to Use Personal Information, and Team Roster (if needed).
Selected teams receive prototype production support (up to 300,000 KRW + company funding) and compete for awards and cash prizes at an in-person final presentation.
en.easyExplanation: The Inha Innovation Center for Engineering Education is recruiting student teams for an industry-coupled problem-solving project, and the application deadline has been extended to October 27 (Tue). Teams of 3 or more undergraduate students (학부생) that include at least one 3rd-year or higher engineering student are eligible to apply. Selected teams receive prototyping funds, and up to 1,000,000 KRW in prize money will be awarded at the final presentation in December.
en.target: Teams composed of 3 or more undergraduate students (학부생), which must include at least 1 student in their 3rd year or higher in an engineering field (공학계열 3학년 이상 학생 1인 반드시 포함). Team members cannot apply to multiple teams, and works that have previously won awards in other contests/competitions are not eligible.
en.eventInfo: In-person final presentation and evaluation (성과발표회/최종심사)

en.title: Admissions Guide for 2027-1 Graduate School 1st Round Regular Admissions (Domestic)
summary: This is the first round of regular admissions for domestic applicants to the Graduate School (Master's, Integrated MS/PhD, and PhD programs) for Spring 2027.
Online application and document submission run from October 19, 2026 (Mon) 10:00 to November 6, 2026 (Fri) 18:00.

Applicants must complete the online application, pay the application fee, print the form, and submit all required original documents in person or by post to the Graduate School Administration Office by the deadline.
Department interviews will be conducted from November 12, 2026 (Thu) to November 18, 2026 (Wed); specific dates and locations must be checked on the graduate school website.
Admissions results will be announced on December 14, 2026 (Mon), followed by deposit registration from December 14 (Mon) to December 16 (Wed).
en.easyExplanation: This notice is for domestic students applying to Inha University's Graduate School (Master's, Integrated MS/PhD, PhD) for the Spring 2027 semester. Applicants must hold or be expected to hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree; current students enrolled in Inha Graduate School (재적 중인 학생), full-time faculty, and international applicants eligible for the International Track cannot apply here. You must complete your online application and submit all required original documents by November 6, 2026 at 18:00.
en.target: Master's & Integrated MS/PhD: Those who hold or are expected to hold a Bachelor's degree from a regular university in Korea or abroad prior to admission (or recognized as equivalent by law) / PhD: Those who hold or are expected to hold a Master's degree from a regular university in Korea or abroad prior to admission (or recognized as equivalent by law) ※ Ineligible: Currently enrolled students at Inha University Graduate School (재적 중인 학생), full-time faculty of Inha University, and applicants eligible for the International Admissions track (foreigners whose parents are both foreign nationals, or foreigners/overseas Koreans who completed all elementary, secondary, and tertiary education abroad).
en.eventInfo: Department admissions interviews, held in designated locations for each department.

en.title: [Undergraduate - External Scholarship] Notice on Selection of 2026 Insong Cultural Foundation Scholars
summary: The Insong Cultural Foundation is selecting scholarship recipients for the 2026 academic year to provide 2,000,000 KRW per year as a living expense scholarship.

Applicants must be regular semester enrolled students (재학생) who have completed at least 1 semester (이수) with 2 or more semesters remaining until graduation, with both previous semester and cumulative percentile scores of 80 or higher, at least 12 credits completed in the previous semester, and within income bracket 8 for 2026-2 (graduating semester students are ineligible).

Recipients of external living-expense scholarships of 510,000 KRW or more are ineligible to apply; concurrent receipt is allowed only for national scholarships (국가장학금) and certain on-campus scholarships.
Original application documents must be submitted in person to the Student Welfare Team (장학복지팀) on the 3rd floor of the Student Center by Friday, October 23, 2026, 17:00.
en.easyExplanation: The Insong Cultural Foundation is offering a living expense scholarship of 2,000,000 KRW for one year for the 2026 academic year. Regular enrolled students (재학생) who have completed at least 1 semester with 2+ semesters left until graduation, a GPA percentile of 80+, and an income decile of 8 or below may apply (students in their final graduating semester and recipients of external living-expense scholarships of 510,000 KRW or more are excluded). Interested students must prepare required documents, including a recommendation form, and submit them in person to the Student Welfare Team (장학복지팀) by October 23, 17:00.
en.target: Regular semester enrolled students (재학생) who have completed at least 1 semester (이수) and have 2 or more semesters remaining until graduation (students in their graduating semester are not eligible). Those with both a previous semester and cumulative average percentile score of 80 or higher, and who completed at least 12 credits in the previous semester. Within Korea Student Aid Foundation income bracket 8 or below for the 2026-2 semester. Students with high academic enthusiasm and excellent grades despite difficult family circumstances. Recipients of external scholarships (other foundations, corporations, local governments) for living expenses of 510,000 KRW or more are not eligible (concurrent receipt is allowed only for National Scholarships, on-campus scholarships, work-study scholarships, volunteer scholarships, and universal scholarships; only those who have not received other scholarships as of the document submission date are eligible). Those who discontinue studies during the scholarship period due to graduation, leave of absence, withdrawal, or disciplinary action (except advancement to higher education), or who lose eligibility criteria such as falling below 80 points, are disqualified.

en.title: [Undergraduate-Off-Campus Scholarship] 2026 2nd Semester Myungin Multicultural Scholarship Foundation University Student Selection
summary: The Myungin Multicultural Scholarship Foundation is selecting university students for the 2nd semester of 2026 to provide a living expense scholarship of 4,000,000 KRW per person.

Eligible applicants are children of multicultural families currently enrolled in domestic universities (1st year 2nd semester, 2nd year, or 3rd year) whose household income is at or below 100% of the 2026 median income.

Exclusions apply: families where both parents hold foreign nationality, North Korean defectors, students currently on leave of absence (휴학생), students in their first semester after admission/returning (복학/입학), first-semester transfer students, and students in their final semester before graduation.
Applications must arrive by mail at the Myungin Multicultural Scholarship Foundation by October 30, 2026 (Fri).

Applicants must submit original documents including the scholarship application, self-introduction, privacy consent form, enrollment certificate, transcript, and required family/health insurance documents.

Students on leave (휴학생), students in their first semester (admission, return from leave, transfer), final-semester students, families where both parents are foreigners, and North Korean defectors are not eligible. Applications must arrive via postal mail by October 30, 2026 (Fri).

summary: Selection of Eunpyeong-gu Resident Scholarship recipients for the second half of 2026 (up to 2 million KRW per person, tuition-coverage scholarship).

Eligibility: University students who have continuously resided in Eunpyeong-gu (은평구) for 2 years or more as of the announcement date (Oct 8, 2026), are enrolled (재학) for the Fall 2026 semester, achieved a GPA of 3.0/4.5 or higher in Spring 2026, and are within the 8th student aid income quintile (학자금 지원 소득구간 8구간 이내) for Fall 2026.

You must submit the required documents via registered mail or in person by October 28 at 18:00.
en.target: University students who meet all of the following: 1) Continuously resided in Eunpyeong-gu (은평구) for 2 years or more as of the announcement date (Oct 8, 2026) (exceptions apply if residing in other areas due to academic reasons); 2) Enrolled (재학) for the Fall 2026 semester; 3) Achieved a GPA of 3.0/4.5 or higher in Spring 2026; 4) Within the 8th student aid income quintile (학자금 지원 소득구간 8구간 이내) for Fall 2026.

en.title: [Undergraduate - Off-campus Scholarship] 2027 Daesan Rural Foundation Scholarship Selection Guide
summary: The Daesan Rural Foundation (대산농촌재단) is selecting scholarship recipients for the 2027 academic year.

Eligible applicants are undergraduate students enrolled (재학생) in their 2nd semester of the 2nd year or higher at a domestic 4-year university, who plan to work in the agricultural sector after graduation and have a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or higher (out of 4.5).
Selected students will receive full tuition support until graduation (up to 4 semesters) and participate in the next-generation agricultural talent training program.
Applications must be submitted directly to the foundation's email (dsa@dsa.or.kr) by Wednesday, November 11, 2026.
Application forms can be downloaded from the foundation's website (www.dsa.or.kr).
en.easyExplanation: This scholarship is for undergraduate students in their 2nd semester of the 2nd year or higher who plan to work in the agricultural sector after graduation. To apply, you must be an enrolled student (재학생) with a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or higher, and selected students will receive full tuition until graduation. If interested, please submit your application directly to the foundation's email by November 11.
en.target: Undergraduate students enrolled (재학생) in their 2nd semester of the 2nd year or higher at a domestic 4-year university, who have a strong will and practical plan to work in the agricultural sector after graduation and grow into agricultural leaders (farming, agricultural research, distribution, etc.), with a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or higher (out of 4.5) up to the previous semester. (Preference given to those who wish to farm with a farming foundation, or students majoring in agricultural fields).

en.title: [Undergraduate - Off-campus Scholarship] Notice of Selection for 2027 Asan Social Welfare Foundation Scholarship for North Korean Defector Youth
summary: The Asan Social Welfare Foundation is selecting North Korean defector youth scholars for 2027.

summary: 인사혁신처의 2027년 전국 지역인재 7급 수습직원 선발시험 변경사항 안내입니다.
학교추천 성적요건이 기존 학과 성적 상위 10% 이내에서 상위 15% 이내로 완화됩니다 (졸업예정자 및 졸업자 동일 적용).
2027년부터 PSAT 시험이 별도 검정시험으로 분리되어, 전국 지역인재 7급 원서접수 이전에 반드시 PSAT 심화 응시원서를 별도로 접수해야 합니다.
학교 추천 확정 전이라도 접수 기간 내에 반드시 PSAT 심화 시험 원서를 접수해야 하며, 미접수 시 지역인재 7급 원서접수가 불가합니다.
2027년도 공직적격성평가(PSAT) 시행계획은 2026년 11월 중 국가공무원채용시스템에 공고될 예정입니다.
analysis.easyExplanation: 2027년부터 전국 지역인재 7급 수습직원 선발시험의 학교 추천 성적 기준이 상위 10%에서 상위 15% 이내로 완화됩니다. 또한, 앞으로는 시험 지원 전에 반드시 PSAT 심화 시험 원서를 따로 접수해야 하므로, 학교 추천을 받기 전이라도 기간 내에 꼭 접수하시기 바랍니다. 자세한 계획은 올해 11월에 공고될 예정입니다.

en.title: Notice of Future Changes to the National Regional Talent Grade 7 Probationary Employee Selection Exam
summary: Notice of changes to the National Regional Talent Grade 7 Probationary Employee Selection Exam starting from 2027 by the Ministry of Personnel Management.
The academic requirement for school recommendation will be relaxed from the top 10% to the top 15% of the department (applies to both prospective graduates and graduates).
Starting in 2027, the PSAT will be separated as an independent test; applicants must register for the Advanced PSAT (PSAT 심화) separately before applying for the Grade 7 exam.
Applicants must register for the Advanced PSAT during its registration period even before school recommendation is finalized; failure to register prevents Grade 7 exam application.
The detailed '2027 Public Service Aptitude Test (PSAT) Implementation Plan' is scheduled to be announced on the National Public Candidate Recruitment System in November.
en.easyExplanation: Starting from 2027, the academic requirement for school recommendation for the National Regional Talent Grade 7 Exam will be relaxed from the top 10% to the top 15%. Also, you must register for the Advanced PSAT exam separately before applying for the Grade 7 exam, so please make sure to register during the period even before your school recommendation is confirmed. Detailed plans will be announced in November.
en.target: Applicants for the National Regional Talent Grade 7 Probationary Employee Selection Exam (Prospective graduates: graduation ranking ratio within the top 15% of each department/major based on the GPA of all completed courses at the time of recommendation; Graduates: graduation ranking ratio within the top 15% of each department)

en.title: [Undergraduate - Off-campus Scholarship] 2026 Daejeon Youth Tomorrow Foundation Achievement (Univ) Scholarship Selection Notice (Period Extended)
summary: The Daejeon Youth Tomorrow Foundation (대전청년내일재단) provides a living expense scholarship (1.5 million KRW) for university students from Daejeon studying at universities outside of Daejeon.

Applicants must be Korean citizens in their 2nd year or higher, and either the student or their parents must have resided in Daejeon Metropolitan City continuously for at least one year as of the announcement date (Sep 1, 2026).
Must meet the academic criteria of a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or higher (out of 4.5) up to the previous semester and have completed at least 12 credits in the previous semester.
Students on leave of absence (휴학생), graduation delayers (졸업유예생), coursework completed students (수료생), extra-semester students (초과학기생), and graduate students (대학원생) are excluded.
Applications must be submitted online through the Daejeon Youth Portal (대전청년포털) by October 8, 2026 (Thu) at 17:00.

To obtain the university president's official seal, students must first have their academic advisor or department chair fill out the recommendation letter before visiting the Scholarship and Welfare Team (장학복지팀).
en.easyExplanation: The application period for the living expense scholarship (1.5 million KRW) has been extended for students in their 2nd year or higher who are from Daejeon but attend universities outside of Daejeon (such as Inha University). Either you or your parents must have lived in Daejeon for at least one year, and you must meet the GPA (3.5+) and credit (12+ credits in the previous semester) requirements. Students on leave of absence (휴학생), coursework completed students (수료생), or extra-semester students (초과학기생) cannot apply, and applications must be submitted online via the Daejeon Youth Portal by October 8 at 17:00.
en.target: Korean citizens in their 2nd year or higher (2학년 이상) attending a domestic university outside of Daejeon, who have received a recommendation from the university president or dean, and whose self or parents have continuously resided in Daejeon Metropolitan City for at least one year as of the announcement date (Sep 1, 2026). Must have a cumulative GPA of 3.5 or higher (out of 4.5) up to the previous semester and have earned at least 12 credits in the previous semester. Exclusions: Those with disciplinary actions (suspension or higher), criminal punishment or social controversy, those who provided false information, those not enrolled (on leave of absence (휴학), dropped out (자퇴), etc.) as of the final announcement date, graduation delayers (졸업유예생), coursework completed students (수료생), extra-semester students (초과학기생/정규학기 초과 등록자), graduate students (대학원생), those who earned fewer than 12 credits in the previous semester, students of unaccredited schools, cyber/remote universities, Korea National Open University, and recipients of the Daejeon Youth Tomorrow Foundation's 2026 first-half Talent Promotion (Science, Kumdori) Scholarship.

en.title: Notice on Certificate Issuance for Micro-Major Completers (Spring 2026)
summary: Information on issuing Micro-Major Certificates for students who completed a micro-major in Spring 2026.
Certificates can be issued by logging into the Online Certificate System (https://cert.inha.ac.kr) and selecting 'Micro-Major Certificate' (마이크로전공 인증서).
Completion is automatically granted and listed on official transcripts once 3 or more courses (9+ credits) are completed via standard course registration without prior application.
Micro-majors are open to all students, but primary majors (주전공자) and double majors (복수전공 이수자) of the hosting department are not allowed to enroll.
Certification may be revoked if credits are deleted due to grade cancellation or getting an F upon retaking a course, causing the total to fall below requirements.
en.easyExplanation: Students who completed at least 3 courses (9 credits) in a micro-major can issue a Micro-Major Certificate (마이크로전공 인증서) through the Online Certificate System. Please note that applications may close early on a first-come, first-served basis (limited to 20 applicants).
en.target: Inha University students (인하대학교 학생) who are able to attend the main contest on November 5, 2026.

en.title: [Notice] Guidance on Attendance Recognition for Undergraduate Students, 2nd Semester 2026
summary: Guidance on the operation of attendance recognition for undergraduate students in the 2nd semester of 2026

Application procedure: submit a request via the portal system → Academic Affairs Internet Application → Attendance Recognition Application within 10 days of the reason occurring, then submit supporting documents to the department office

Recognized reasons include illness/accident, death of a direct relative/spouse/sibling, military service duties, department-approved practicum/academic conference/presentation/contest, athlete training/competition, employment interviews or early employment/startup for students expected to graduate, work duties for employed learners, and childbirth, each with its own recognized period/class-hour limits
The department issues an attendance recognition confirmation, and the instructor in charge confirms it before granting attendance recognition
Supporting documents may be submitted directly to the department office or by email (juheekang@inha.ac.kr)
The program usage period runs from Mon., Aug. 31, 2026 to Fri., Dec. 4, 2026, and related forms are provided in the attachment
en.easyExplanation: This notice explains how undergraduate students in the 2nd semester of 2026 can get attendance recognized when specific reasons occur, such as illness, family bereavement, military duties, academic conference participation, or job interviews. Students must apply through the portal within 10 days of the reason occurring and submit supporting documents to their department office, so missing this window may make recognition difficult.
en.target: Undergraduate students who have one of the listed reasons: illness/accident, death of a direct relative/spouse/sibling, military service duties (병무), practicum/academic conference/presentation/contest approved by the department head, athlete training/competition approved by the Student Affairs director, job interviews for students expected to graduate, early employment/startup for students expected to graduate (last-semester registrants), work duties/business trips for employed learners approved by the Future Convergence College department head, childbirth of the student or spouse, or other cases approved by the President as necessary

en.title: 2026 Fall Semester Undergraduate Attendance Recognition Guidelines
summary: The Academic Affairs Team announces the operational procedures for attendance recognition (출석인정) based on the 'Regulations on Grade Processing and Reporting'
Application procedure: Apply via the portal system (학적인터넷신청 → 출석인정신청), then submit supporting documents to the department office within 10 days of the reason occurring
The department confirms the documents and issues an attendance recognition certificate, which the course instructor then verifies before recognizing attendance

Recognized reasons include illness/accident, death of immediate family, military service, participation in practicum/academic conferences/competitions, athlete training, job interviews, early employment/startup, work duties for employed learners, and childbirth, each with different allowed periods

For reasons 'C, D, F, and J' up to 1/2 of class hours may be recognized, and for reason 'G' up to 3/4; if recognized hours reach 1/4 or more, the instructor must assign an alternative arrangement and submit a result confirmation to the department office
Related forms are available in the attached files: 'Attendance Recognition Application Program Guide' and 'Regulations on Grade Processing and Reporting'
en.easyExplanation: This notice explains the procedure for undergraduate students to get official attendance recognition when they miss class due to specific approved reasons like illness, family bereavement, or job interviews. When such a reason occurs, students apply through the portal and submit supporting documents to their department office within 10 days, after which the department and instructor verify and approve the attendance recognition. There is no fixed application deadline or event date; it applies individually whenever a qualifying reason arises.
en.target: Undergraduate students experiencing one of the following: illness/accident requiring hospitalization or equivalent, death of a direct ascendant/descendant, spouse, or sibling, conscription examination/reserve forces training, participation in practicum, academic conferences, presentations, or competitions approved by the department head, athlete training/competition participation approved by the Student Affairs office, job interviews for students expecting to graduate, early employment/startup for students expecting to graduate (registered in their final semester), work duties or business trips for employed learners approved by the College of Convergence department head, childbirth (self or spouse), or other cases approved by the President as necessary

en.title: [On-Campus] Guidelines for Using Personal Mobility (PM) Devices on Campus for Fall 2026
summary: Notice on safety regulations for using personal mobility (PM) devices (electric kickboards, segways, electric bicycles, etc.) on campus for the Fall 2026 semester.

Rules of use: Must wear protective gear including helmets (entry to campus prohibited without a helmet), strictly 1 person per device, park only in designated PM parking zones, must hold a motorized bicycle license (원동기장치자전거면허) or higher, and entry to sports fields and running tracks is prohibited.
Fines under the Road Traffic Act: 100,000 KRW for driving without a license, 20,000 KRW for not wearing a helmet, 40,000 KRW for exceeding passenger capacity, 100,000 KRW for drunk driving, etc.
Emergency contact numbers in case of accident: Control Room (24 hours: 032-860-9119), General Affairs Team (032-860-7092), Student Support Team (032-860-7064).
en.easyExplanation: This notice provides safety rules for riding personal mobility devices like electric kickboards or e-bikes on campus. You must hold at least a motorized bicycle license to ride, and you must wear a helmet (entry is banned without one) and ride alone. You must park only in designated PM parking zones, and traffic violations may result in legal fines.
en.target: Users of personal mobility (PM) devices on campus (only those holding a motorized bicycle license (원동기장치자전거면허) or higher are permitted to ride)

If a student whose leave has expired does not apply for extension or reinstatement, they will be expelled for failure to reinstate.
en.target: General leave of absence: currently enrolled Inha University students (재학생); once 3/4 of class days have passed, a grade is assigned for that semester and leave is no longer possible. Foreign nationals, students belonging to discontinued departments (폐과소속자), and new/transfer students taking their first-semester leave (limited to those able to take leave for reasons such as military enlistment within 3/4 of class days) must apply in person at their college administrative office. Military leave of absence: enrolled students expecting to be enlisted—online application if the enlistment date falls within 3/4 of class days, in-person application if it falls after that point (2026 new/transfer students with an enlistment date before the 3/4 point of class days must also apply in person). Reinstatement: students on leave whose leave period has expired or who wish to be reinstated before it expires. However, students on leave for the current semester cannot apply for reinstatement (they must first cancel their leave through their college administrative office before applying).

en.title: [Academic Affairs] Notice on New Reinstatement (Return from Leave of Absence) Application System (Starting from 2026 Spring Semester)
summary: A new reinstatement application system for students on leave of absence will be introduced starting from the 2026 Spring Semester
Eligible: students on leave whose leave period has expired or who wish to be reinstated before it expires (students who took leave in the current semester are excluded)
Change in processing: reinstatement is now only completed when all three conditions—course registration, tuition payment, and reinstatement application approval—are met
Reinstatement application period: February 1 / August 1 through the end of the course add/drop period (until the Sunday of the first week of the semester)
How to apply: apply via Portal > Academic Records (학적) > Academic Records Online Application > (Application Type) Reinstatement, then check college approval status
Note: students whose leave period has expired will be dismissed for failure to reinstate if they neither extend their leave nor apply for reinstatement
en.easyExplanation: Starting from the 2026 Spring Semester, students on leave of absence must not only complete course registration and tuition payment but also receive approval for their reinstatement application in order to be reinstated as enrolled students. Reinstatement applications must be submitted through the portal between February 1 or August 1 and the end of the course add/drop period (the Sunday of the first week of the semester), and students who took leave in the current semester cannot apply for reinstatement—they must first cancel their leave at their college's administrative office.
en.target: Students on leave of absence whose leave period has expired or who wish to be reinstated before it expires. However, students who took leave of absence in the current semester cannot apply for reinstatement (if such students wish to be reinstated, they must visit their college's administrative office to cancel their leave of absence before applying for reinstatement).

en.title: 2025 Academic Year Department of Data Science Multiple Major (Minor/Double Major) Selection Criteria and Graduation Requirements Guide
summary: Guide to selection criteria and graduation requirements for multiple majors (minor/double major) in the Department of Data Science
For a minor, 12 credits of required major courses and 9 credits of elective major courses are needed, totaling 21 credits
For a double major, 12 credits of required major courses and 27 credits of elective major courses are needed, totaling 39 credits
Required major courses include Statistical Machine Learning, Data Science Programming, Regression Analysis, and Numerical Analysis and Optimization, with some substitute courses recognized

Due to the 2025 curriculum reorganization, 'Basic Statistics' changed from a required major course to a foundational major course; completing a substitute course only allows application for multiple majors, and Statistical Machine Learning must be separately completed to graduate (applies starting from the 2025 second semester multiple major applications)
The passing cutoff score from the previous semester cannot be disclosed
en.easyExplanation: This is a guide for students applying for a minor or double major in the Department of Data Science, covering selection criteria and graduation requirements. Minor students must complete 21 total credits and double major students must complete 39 total credits; starting from the 2025 second semester, completing only a substitute for Basic Statistics allows application for a multiple major but does not fulfill graduation requirements—Statistical Machine Learning must also be completed. Please refer to the tables in the notice for detailed courses and substitute course recognition.
en.target: Students who wish to apply for or complete a multiple major (minor or double major) in the Department of Data Science. Starting from the 2025 second semester multiple major applications, completing a substitute course for 'Basic Statistics (기초통계학, DSC1006)' allows only application for a multiple major, and students must separately complete Statistical Machine Learning (통계적 기계학습, DSC3001) to graduate

인하포털사이트에서 온라인 신청 후 신청확인서를 인쇄하여 소프트웨어융합대학 행정실에 방문 제출해야 합니다.
개인환불금이 있는 경우 등록금납부확인서 및 통장사본(타인 명의 계좌인 경우 가족증명서 포함)을 제출해야 합니다.
국가장학금 수혜 내역이 있는 경우 국가장학금 반환 서약서를 함께 제출해야 합니다.
휴학 승인일에 따라 등록금 반환 금액이 달라지므로 서류를 빠르게 제출해야 하며, 수업일수 3/4선 초과 시 휴학이 불가합니다.
analysis.easyExplanation: 수업일수 1/4선 이후부터 3/4선 사이에 중도휴학을 신청하려는 학생을 위한 절차 안내입니다. 포털에서 온라인 신청 후 서류를 출력하여 소프트웨어융합대학 행정실에 직접 제출해야 합니다. 제출 및 승인 시점에 따라 등록금 환불 금액이 달라지며, 수업일수 3/4선이 지나면 휴학을 신청할 수 없습니다.

en.title: [Notice] Mid-Semester Leave of Absence Application Procedure
summary: Information on the procedure and tuition refund guidelines for applying for a mid-semester leave of absence between 1/4 and 3/4 of class days.
Applicants must apply online via Inha Portal, print the application confirmation, and submit it in person to the College of Software Convergence Administrative Office.
If eligible for a personal refund, students must submit a tuition payment receipt and bankbook copy (family relationship certificate required if using another person's account).
Students who have received National Scholarships (국가장학금) must also submit a National Scholarship Refund Pledge.
Because tuition refund amounts depend on the approval date, required documents must be submitted promptly; leave of absence is not permitted after 3/4 of class days.
en.easyExplanation: This guide is for students wishing to apply for a mid-semester leave of absence between 1/4 and 3/4 of class days. After applying online via Inha Portal, you must print the confirmation form and submit required documents in person to the College of Software Convergence Administrative Office (소프트웨어융합대학 행정실). Refund amounts depend on when approval is completed, and applications are not accepted after 3/4 of class days.
en.target: Students wishing to apply for mid-semester leave of absence between 1/4 and 3/4 of class days (leave of absence is not allowed after 3/4 of class days)
